official_sources: HMLR Practice Guide 79 local land charges
official local land charge certificate guidance
official_measurement_examples: PG63 was updated 13 April 2026 and covers Land Charges Department records for unregistered land
PG63 expressly does not cover local land charges
Local Land Charges programme status was updated 20 July 2026
not every local authority is yet on the national digital LLC service
a local land charge can restrict use even if the user-facing national service does not yet hold that authority's data
Land Charges searches and Local Land Charges searches serve different legal registers
a search result is evidence of the searched register and date rather than complete title/planning clearance
charge/search status does not establish ownership access capacity or final development yield
core_rules: Land Charges register is not Local Land Charges register
national LLC service coverage is authority-specific
no online result is not universal no-charge proof
search certificate is not planning permission
planning condition may appear as LLC but LLC search is not planning history substitute
land charge entry is not ownership
land charge entry is not cadastral boundary
unregistered-land charge search is distinct from title register
search does not prove access rights
search does not calculate development yield
no parcel land-charge clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
source_verification_note: Official HM Land Registry, GOV.UK and legislation sources checked 2026-07-26. PG63 13 April 2026 and Local Land Charges Programme 20 July 2026 updates retained with register/service-coverage separation; no parcel promotion.
